title: Billing, Payment and Audit Arrangements under the Insurer Program Agreements
content:
Under the Insurer Program Agreements, the tier of the insurer's agreement decides how scans, deductibles and rental days are billed, how soon the insurer pays a repair invoice and how much of the closed work it may audit:

1. **Scan billing** — whether pre- and post-repair scans are billable lines on the insurer's repairs.
2. **Deductible collection** — whether the network collects the deductible from the customer on the insurer's behalf.
3. **Rental direct billing** — whether rental days on the insurer's claims are billed directly to the insurer.
4. **Invoice payment terms** — the calendar days after a repair invoice within which the insurer pays.
5. **Audit sample** — the share of closed files the insurer may audit each quarter, in percent.

| Agreement tier | Scans billable | Network collects deductible | Rental billed directly to insurer | Invoice payment terms (calendar days) | Audit sample per quarter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | Yes | Yes | No | 30 | 0% |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5% |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5% |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | 21 | 10% |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | 15 | 10% |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | 15 | 10% |

## Notes by column

- Scans and deductible collection read "Yes" in every tier.
- Rental days are billed directly to the insurer under every tier except the Network Referral Agreement.
- Payment terms run in calendar days from the date of the repair invoice.
- The audit sample is the share of the quarter's closed files the insurer may audit; under a Network Referral Agreement it is 0%.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- A repair invoice dated 10 March under a Premier Direct Repair Agreement falls due for payment within 21 calendar days after that date, that is by 31 March.
- The same invoice under a Select Direct Repair Agreement falls due within 30 calendar days after 10 March, that is by 9 April.
- In a quarter in which 200 files close under a Managed Repair Program Agreement, the insurer may audit 10% of them, that is up to 20 files; under a Preferred Direct Repair Agreement, 5%, up to 10 files.

The dates and file counts are invented for the illustrations.
